status: Rebuilt on @pepbits components (27 October 2026). The flow, steps, fields, validation, API calls/payloads, empty and error states and disabled links follow the source pages listed below; markup and styling are the library's own (@pepbits/ui, @pepbits/components, @pepbits/patterns, @pepbits/icons and semantic theme tokens). The copied primitives, CSS module and generated Tailwind theme were removed.
reason: Owner-requested front desk pages 'Start a visit' and 'Emergency registration' in the AllyVora Patients module. First copied verbatim (26 October 2026); rebuilt on the shared @pepbits components because the copy did not follow them.

files.target: StartVisit.tsx (behaviour and API calls; rebuilt UI)
EmergencyRegistration.tsx (behaviour and API calls; rebuilt UI)
lib.ts (clock, initials; the pages now format times with the host time preference)

removed: kit.tsx (Avatar, MrnChip, Tip, Notice, Pills) -> @pepbits/ui Avatar, IconButton, Segmented; module Notice (../support.tsx)

ui.tsx (Button, Field, Input, Select, Textarea, TextField, SelectField, Badge, Kbd, ErrorNote, useToast, useDebounced, cn) -> @pepbits/ui Button, Input, DateInput, Select, Textarea, Checkbox, Radio, Badge, cn; parts.tsx Kbd/ProblemList/useToast/useDebounced
start-visit.module.css (control sizes) -> density preference and --fs-scale tokens
styles.css and scripts/allyvora-front-desk-styles.mjs (generated source Tailwind theme) -> library theme tokens
lucide-react dependency (CircleDot, FolderOpen, Ambulance, HelpCircle, UserCheck) -> @pepbits/icons Activity, FolderHeart, Truck, CircleHelp, UserRound
adaptations: Progress uses the @pepbits/patterns/wizard WizardStepper (read-only, laid out as one row through its classNames slots); the step is still derived from page state as in the source.

next/link and next/navigation are replaced by link.tsx: /registration -> /allyvora-patients/patients/new, /front-desk/visits/new -> /allyvora-patients/visits/new, /front-desk/emergency -> /allyvora-patients/emergency, /patients/<numeric id> -> patient view (/allyvora-patients/patients/<id>). Other source routes (identity follow-up, identify, appointments, triage, nurse intake, emergency board, clinic queue, workflow hrefs) render disabled with the title 'Not available in this demo'.
useSearchParams('patient') is the route target's recordId (?patient=<id>).
Toasts post to the host notifications (useScreenHost().notify).
Keyboard shortcuts ('/', number keys, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter) and their key hints are active only while the keyboard-shortcut preference is on.
Appointment and visit times use the host time format instead of the source's fixed en-GB clock.

api() drops the source's 401 redirect handler and grant-refusal event; the origin is NEXT_PUBLIC_ALLYVORA_FRONT_DESK_API_URL (default '/api', as in the source). Network failures become ApiError(0) so the pages show their own empty states / error notes.
English only; ar/hi/ml translations are a follow-up (strings pass through the localization translator and fall back to English).

expectedApi.note: Paths are relative to the API origin; the source calls them as /api<path>. Error bodies: {error: string} (+ {mrn} on a duplicate registration conflict). Writes send x-csrf-token from the av_csrf cookie.
expectedApi.GET /front-desk/overview: {appointments: {upcoming: {id, startsAt, clinic, clinicianName?, mode: 'in-person'|'video'|'phone', patient: PatientLite | null}[]}}
expectedApi.GET /patients/{id}/visit-context: {patient: PatientLite, coverage?: {payer?, plan?, memberId?, expiry?, eligibility?} | null, blocked: string[], openVisits: {id, class, status, department, arrivedAt, ward?, bed?}[], appointments: {id, startsAt, clinic, clinicianName?, reason?}[], referrals: {id, status, specialty, referrerName, organisation?, priority, referralDate, reason}[], clinicians: {id, name, role}[], departments: Department[], clinics: Clinic[], arrivalModes: string[], actions: {key, label, description, href?, allowed, unavailable?}[]}
expectedApi.POST /patients/{id}/visits: body {visit: {type: 'walk-in'|'referral'|'emergency', department, reason?, clinicianId?, billing: 'insurance'|'self-pay', priority? (OP), arrivalMode? (ER), referralId? | referral?: ReferralSource}} -> {encounter: {id, class}}
expectedApi.GET /services: {specialties: string[], departments: {code, name, services[], specialties[]}[], clinics: Clinic[], wards: Ward[]}
expectedApi.POST /patients/duplicates: body {givenName, familyName, birthDate, mobile, identifiers: []} -> {patient: PatientLite, reasons: string[], score: number}[]
expectedApi.POST /patients: body identityMode 'unknown' {unidentified: {estimatedAge, arrivalMode, broughtBy, foundAt, referenceNumber, description, belongings}, sex, sensitivity, consents: {emergencyException: true}, visit} or identityMode 'unverified' {givenName, familyName, birthDate, birthDateEstimated, sex, nationality, preferredLanguage, mobile?, identifiers: [], sensitivity, consents: {treatment, privacy, hie, sms, treatmentVersion, privacyVersion, signatureCaptured, signature, signatureDeferredReason, emergencyException}, visit} -> {patient: PatientLite (alias name and TMP-###### MRN when unknown), encounter: {id, class} | null}
